# dsh-worth-check · Worth Check
A DeepSeek plugin that judges task size at the **start of a new conversation** and asks "is this wor
th doing?" only for large projects — preventing impulsive kick-offs you can't cleanly abandon.
中文
## What it does
At the start of every new conversation, before the first task, the model quickly sizes it up:
- **Starts by reading a handoff doc / continuing a previous project** → proceed, don't ask (already

confirmed).
- **Small tasks** (chit-chat, lookups, explanations, typos) → just do it, no interruptio

n.
- **Large projects** → ask "is this worth doing now?" first, then proceed after your answer.
Judged once on the first task only; never re-asked later in the same conversation.
Large-project signals (any one suffices, configurable):

1. Needs a handoff document
2. Needs many context compactions
3. Spans many files or steps
4. Implie
s "project / system / build from scratch"
Reminder-only, never blocking.
## Config
The plugin ships as two components you can toggle independently on the plugin's detail page under "I
ncluded components":
| Component | Default | Purpose |

| Worth check | on | Sizes the task, asks only for large projects, skips handoff reads |
| Fake-need
check | off | Extra "fake need / wasted effort" check, off by default to save tokens |
The main component also has two optional parameters (set in `cordis.yml`, not the GUI):
| Key | Default | Meaning |

| `askOnLargeOnly` | true | Ask only for large projects |
| `largeSignals` | 4 defaults | Large-proj
ect signals, editable |
